evidence: Atlas paper 571 states that it downloaded Sentinel-2 Level-1C imagery with less than 10% cloud cover from the USGS website and gives https://earthexplorer.usgs.gov/ in the Data Availability Statement. Current USGS Sentinel-2 documentation identifies Multi-Spectral Instrument Level-1C products as available for download and documents the 13 spectral bands and Level-1C processing level.
note: The paper also mentions the ESA website in its processing subsection, so exact per-scene acquisition route and identifiers are deferred to Stage 3. No Sentinel-2 scene or band file was downloaded or opened.
